records.finding: The current TS loader imports/caches factories while native loader accepts shared libraries through ice_plugin_register. Inline name/hidden/before-user semantics require a separate native application registration phase; launcher-specific feature implementations remain their area owners.
The frozen loader/SDK require the ice_plugin_register symbol. No claim about availability of historical upstream binaries or releases is made from local source alone.

The frozen refreshLocalModelsForStartup body only loads the raw Omni/local credential and sets ICE_LOCAL_API_KEY. It neither fetches models nor consults the declared skip/refresh/onFailure options. Explicit refreshLocalModels performs /models fetch, validation, provider replacement and atomic-name rename; it returns updated:false on failure. AUTH-027 owns catalog row conversion.

Base URL uses Omni then legacy-local nullish precedence then configured URL/default. ICE_LOCAL_API_KEY is assigned by credential startup and explicit refresh; the cited source does not read it there. ICE_AGENT_VIEW_COLORS is outside AUTH scope.

TS declares off plus seven non-off levels through ultra, including the model-config schema. Native enum/map keys stop at max, so unknown ultra deserialization fails whole config. AI-005 owns runtime thinking/clamping. Actual user-directory imports and the stated three remappings cannot be checked under the explicit ban on real ~/.ice and ~/.icers reads.

Native host child execution exists with allowed-tool narrowing, inherited parent hooks, owner/invocation/run/scope cancellation and strict bounds. The missing layer is TS V2's definition catalog, explicit source-sensitive permission grammar/approvals, durable contracts and persistent child lifecycle. Conditional DLL tests require ICE_TEST_SUBAGENT_LIBRARY and do not establish a repository-shipped companion package.

ICE_SUBAGENT_DECISION_EVENTS, ICE_SUBAGENT_HOOK_EVENTS, ICE_SUBAGENT_OBSERVATION_EVENTS, ICE_SUBAGENT_SETTINGS_LIMITS, ICE_BUILTIN_CHILD_TOOLS, ICE_CAPABILITY_LIMITS, ICE_HOOK_CONTEXT_ADDITION_LIMITS and ICE_HOOK_JOURNAL_ENTRY_TYPE are code constants, not process environment keys. checkpoint/attention are accepted event names without an established active V2 dispatch site.

The ten Cognee overrides and base URL inputs are genuine environment reads. Eight subagent names are exported code constants; Goals host is a Symbol key and agent colors a code alias. ICE_LOCAL_API_KEY at the cited startup/refetch paths is written into the process environment. See individual named-surface dispositions.

Core/CLI references export current session/model state into child-shell environment and remove those names during cleanup; they do not establish CLI startup defaults. Separately, the evals harness does read ICE_PROVIDER plus ICE_MODEL as its default model at ice-harness.ts:48–53, so the claim needs scope correction rather than global exclusion. That harness is assigned to MISC-040–049. No analogous general startup ICE_REASONING_LEVEL read was found in the scoped src search. MISC-040 confirms the eval runner is an actual ICE_MODEL/ICE_PROVIDER consumer with explicit defaults.
ICE_SESSION_FILE is conditional shell-session propagation/cleanup. ICE_LABEL is a local footer label function, not an environment setting.
Startup benchmarking is an application integration; CLI-019 owns its exact caller/output gate and OBS-002 owns timing namespaces. Do not conflate it with ICE_TIMING.

The repository target is source-defined. The old mixed-case URL has a source-proven canonicalization mismatch captured in CLI-045, while the active source intentionally uses lowercase. Actual release availability was not queried, so 'none exist yet' cannot be certified. Prebuilt errors do not trigger an automatic unverified Cargo fallback.

The active Cargo target is icers, config uses .icers and ICERS_CODING_AGENT_DIR, and its default getter returns home/.icers/agent. Active FORK.md documents project .icers and the deliberate split: crate/plugin ABI names remain ice-* / ice_plugin_register. This does not mean every purported TS ICE_* item has a Rust environment reader—several listed items are constants or unsupported features.
